$description: Web Push payloads for the Lading redesign (Norwegian). Sent as JSON by src/lib/push/send.ts and read by public/sw.js. Keep body under ~60 characters. 'tag' groups notifications per plan/session so a new one replaces the previous. 'actions' only render on Android/Chrome; iOS opens 'url' on tap.

events.trigger: Plug-in observed (Disconnected → connected) and no pending plan for the charger

payload.title: Bilen er koblet til
payload.body: Batteri {percent} % (målt {time}). Trykk for å planlegge lading.

events.trigger: Plug-in observed and a pending plan exists

payload.title: Bilen er koblet til
payload.body: Planen er klar – lading starter ca. {startTime}.

events.trigger: Plug-in observed, on_plugin_mode = smart, no user plan; sent once the planner has made blocks

payload.title: Bilen er klar
payload.body: Ladet til ca. {targetPercent} % · {kwh} kWh · ca. {cost} kr.

events.trigger: While charging for a plan, estimated finish passes readyBy (send once per plan)

payload.title: Rekker ikke helt
payload.body: Bilen blir ca. {expectedPercent} % klar {readyBy}. Vi lader videre til {targetPercent} %.

events.trigger: Pending plan, car not connected, now >= latestStartTime − 30 min (send once per plan)

payload.title: Planen venter på bilen
payload.body: Koble til innen {latestStart} for å være klar {readyBy}.

neverNotify: manual start/stop (the person doing it already knows)
